description: Capture a screenshot of a rendered web page via Crawlbase (headless browser + rotating proxies, anti-bot bypass). Returns a stored screenshot_url (JPEG, link expires after about one hour) plus crawl metadata. Requires your Crawlbase JavaScript token as _apiKey — screenshots always render in a real browser. Captures the full page by default; pass mode:"viewport" with width/height to constrain. Example: crawlbase_screenshot({ url: "https://example.com", _apiKey: "your-js-token" })

_apiKey.description: Your Crawlbase JavaScript token (screenshots require browser rendering). Free tier at https://crawlbase.com

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code to route through, e.g. "US", "GB".

height.description: Viewport height in pixels (only applies with mode:"viewport").

mode.description: Capture mode: full rendered page by default; "viewport" captures only the visible area (pair with width/height).

page_wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load before capturing — gives animations/JS time to settle.

scroll.description: Scroll the page before capture to trigger lazy-loaded content.

url.description: The absolute URL of the page to screenshot, e.g. "https://example.com"

width.description: Viewport width in pixels (only applies with mode:"viewport").

name: crawlbase_screenshot
title: Crawlbase Screenshot
